admission.shape: `classDef <name> <prop>:<value>[, ...][;]` with the closed property set plus `:::class` references on sections and leaves
admission.width_policy: wide_240 admission only; narrow_40 measured live
admission.twin_rule: the twin removes the classDef lines and every `:::class` suffix; the outline above the footer must be cell-equal

selection.rule: treemap fallbacks whose only blocker is the closed classDef/::: styling surface

review.reviewer_agent: independent read-only adversarial code review (fresh general-purpose agent, D-452 treemap classDef admission, 2026-11-23)
review.note: Reviewer re-ran the generator --check entry and the live gate and verified: only the five closed classDef properties are admitted with validated values; duplicate classes, duplicate properties, undefined :::-references and malformed suffixes fail closed; the disclosure footer appends after the outline; the class-free twin oracle is cell-exact above the footer.
